user_query: I'm organizing a talent show and I need a list of popular songs from Singapore. Can you provide me with the top 10 songs from the Singapore Songs chart? Also, suggest some popular songs by women that can be performed by the contestants. Additionally, find out the genre of each song to ensure a diverse competition.

TaskList.description: Fetch the top 10 songs from the Singapore Songs chart.
Filter the list of top songs to identify those performed by female artists.
Determine the genre of each song in the list of top 10 songs.
Compile the final list of songs including top 10 songs and selected female artist songs with their genres.
